title: Half-Life 2 running natively on HaikuOS
summary: A developer successfully got Half-Life 2, Valve's classic first-person shooter, running natively on HaikuOS—an open-source BeOS-inspired operating system. This achievement required porting NVIDIA drivers for Turing GPUs and overcoming platform-specific compatibility challenges.
problem_solved: Enables running legacy Windows PC games on an alternative operating system without emulation overhead.
why_valuable: Demonstrates cross-platform gaming capabilities and advances the HaikuOS ecosystem by proving it can handle modern game engines.
